notes: I2 completion. Population P(class|data) from committed I6 (N=10 conductance draws, symmetric log-normal, frozen cuts). 'argmax' = the class the population most members land in; 'conf' = that class's probability. A calibrated signal would show accuracy rising with conf. Reads committed outputs only.

summary.verdict: the population P(class|data) is severely overconfident: not a calibrated posterior
summary.why: Independent mode: accuracy does rise with confidence ([0.333, 0.5, 0.632]), so the signal is weakly monotonic, but at the highest-confidence band (mean conf 0.989) accuracy is only 0.632, far below the probability it claims. The confident-but-wrong set (7 drugs at conf>=0.9) is the systematic low/no-risk overcall (metoprolol, mexiletine, loratadine, tamoxifen, nifedipine, nitrendipine) plus sotalol. The overconfidence concentrates on the structural bias I1/I4 already name.
summary.det_vs_pop_argmax: population argmax does not beat the deterministic call (det 0.607 vs pop 0.571), consistent with I6
